purpose: Provide the shared character animation driver used by player and infected scenes.

animation_selection_v1.configure_clip_selector: configure_clip_selector(selector: Callable) -> void; selector() -> StringName; optional local playback selection, no gameplay state

animation_events_v1.play_one_shot: play_one_shot(state: StringName) -> float; states attack|death|death_forward|death_back|slam|summon (slam/summon need a matching skeletal clip; directional deaths fall back to Death, ADR-0033), returns clip length or 0.0 (death is final)
animation_events_v1.set_active: set_active(active: bool) -> void; pauses animation for distant characters

animation_assets_v1.animation_library: @export AnimationLibrary; optional clip set replacing the model's own clips (ADR-0016)
animation_assets_v1.procedural_gait: @export bool; speed-synchronised leg gait layered over authored clips, presentation only (ADR-0016)
